newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Hainan Beihai Gas Co sets US$35 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: China's Hainan Beihai Gas Co sets US$35 mln loan.

text.p: A US$35 million term loan facility for Hainan Beihai Gas Co Ltd is in syndication, arranger OCBC Singapore said Wednesday.

The facility, guaranteed by Hainan International Trust and Investment Corp (HITIC), has a maturity of five years and an average life of 3.2 years. It pays a margin of 145 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
The front-end fees are 235 basis points for senior managers committing US$5 million or more and 220 basis points for managers committing US$3 million or more.
Proceeds of the loan will be used to partially finance the building of a jetty, gas and oil storage and work stations, a gas distribution network and other related facilities in Haikou, China.

Security for the facility is provided by guarantees such as a letter of support issued by the Haikou city government, a letter of comfort issued by the Hainan provincial government and an undertaking from the shareholders and HITIC jointly and severally to complete the project on time and to meet all cost overruns.
